chapter.heading: Living Sacrifices to God
chapter.v:
I beseech
you therefore, brethren, by the mercies of God, that you present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable to God, which is your reasonable service. [Rom. 1:1]

And do
not be conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind, that you may prove what is that good and acceptable and perfect will of God.Serve God with Spiritual Gifts [[Acts 15:9]]

For I
say, through the grace given to me, to everyone who is among you, not to think of himself more highly than he ought to think, but to think soberly, as God has dealt to each one a measure of faith. [Rom. 1:7]

For as
we have many members in one body, but all the members do not have the same function, [Rom. 1:8]

so we,
being many, are one body in Christ, and individually members of one another. [[1 Cor. 12:8]]

he who
exhorts, in exhortation; he who gives, with liberality; he who leads, with diligence; he who shows mercy, with cheerfulness.Behave Like a Christian [1 Thess. 3:13;]

Let love
be without hypocrisy. Abhor what is evil. Cling to what is good. [Deut. 7:9;]

not lagging
in diligence, fervent in spirit, serving the Lord;

distributing to
the needs of the saints, given to hospitality. [2 Cor. 11:4]

Bless those
who persecute you; bless and do not curse. [John 4:2]

Rejoice with
those who rejoice, and weep with those who weep.

Be of
the same mind toward one another. Do not set your mind on high things, but associate with the humble. Do not be wise in your own opinion. [1 Cor. 16:15,]

Repay no
one evil for evil. Have regard for good things in the sight of all men. [[1 Cor. 2:1,]

If it
is possible, as much as depends on you, live peaceably with all men. [1 Cor. 2:14]

Beloved, do
not avenge yourselves, but rather give place to wrath; for it is written, “Vengeance is Mine, I will repay,” says the Lord. [Is. 29:14]

Therefore“If your
enemy is hungry, feed him;If he is thirsty, give him a drink;For in so doing you will heap coals of fire on his head.” [Job 12:17;] [Is. 19:12; 33:18]

Do not
be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good. [Dan. 2:20;]
